data.one_liner: CLI to convert Dart test JSON output to JUnit XML and provide models
data.what_it_does: It parses the JSON output from Dart's test reporter into developer-friendly models and can generate a JUnit XML report for CI tools. The package also offers a command-line tool to perform this conversion directly from the terminal.
use_when: Generating CI-friendly JUnit reports from Dart test runs
Parsing test JSON into reusable Dart models for custom reporting
Automating test report generation in CI pipelines
avoid_when: When you need a fully-featured, production-ready test reporting solution
When you only need basic test output without XML conversion
strengths: Single package for parsing and CLI conversion
Easy global installation via pub global activate
weaknesses: No built-in support for non-CI use cases
data.minimal_example:
```bash
pub global activate better_test_reporter
report_to_junit --input test_report.json --output report.xml
```
